notes.title: Spinball 2.0
notes.content:
# Spinball 2.0 Release Notes

* Improved random arena algorithm to provide a better distribution of arenas
* Added mod support for music, logos, arenas, challenges, commentary, and settings
* Teams now start with random colors instead of always red vs blue
* Made shadows blurrier
* Made CPU players have a random number of paddles, heavily weighted towards 2 or 3
* Added control scheme info to pause screen during game
* Tied controller configuration to gamepad id
* Added ability to change number of paddles in between games of a match
* Fixed a bug where the stats page didn't show the right badge color for players
* Spins now have a higher initial value so tapping results in a bigger kick
* When the ball hasn’t been touched yet, a blue indicator will oscillate around it to help players find it
* Arrows on the spin indicator are now angled
* Circles no longer will have a random light tan background color
* Fixed saves so they don't appear when it would not have been a goal
* Added a rate limit to saves
* Added a maximum range to saves
* Changed the arena selector UI to show the actual arena that will be used
* Added magnet ball mode - the ball will be attracted to the closest player on the team that last touched the ball
* Added gravity mode - everything will be given gravity and the game will be played as thought it was viewed from the side instead of the top down
* Added clear stats button
* DASH is now it’s own button instead of the result of pressing both spin buttons together
* New arena added: TRIANGLES

notes.title: SPINBALL Official Release!
notes.content:
It's finally here! We are officially releasing Spinball on Tuesday, October 1st - but if you already own Spinball, you can update the game to the release version now!

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Tutorial - a step-by-step walk-through of how to play the game
[*] Challenge Mode - a campaign of 20+ challenges to complete in single player mode
[*] Profiles - save your setup and track your statistics
[*] Leaderboard - become the best at Spinball!
[*] Advanced Settings - change the ball size, the AI difficulty, and after-goal behavior
[*] Series Mode - Play best of 3, 5, 7, or 9 game matches
[*] Commentary - Text commentary and player thoughts during games!
[/list]

notes.title: Spinball Change of Direction
notes.content:
Hi Steam,

First of all, the bad news - Spinball Online is unfortunately not going to happen. Our small team has been stretched thin and our lack of resources has finally caught up to us. Despite our efforts, we aren't going to be able to bring online multiplayer to Spinball.

However, we have decided that in lieu of that, we want to give you more content! The final release will have Challenge Mode, where you can test your skills in more than a dozen challenges! The final number is not yet determined, but it's likely that we will also open up modding so that you can create your own challenges as well :D

We will also most likely be adding a few more arenas, so please stay tuned! We are excited to finally remove the 'early access' tag from this game, and we look forward to that day very soon!

-BPG

notes.title: Version 1.2 Now Available!
notes.content:
Hi Steam!

We've been in early access for a little under 6 months. Trust me - that was not the original plan. We have been working hard to bring you online multiplayer in Spinball, but until that day comes, we have added an extra arena and made some other tweaks and adjustments. We're currently alpha testing the online mode and once we're ready to start beta testing, we will make a beta build available here for all of you to try it out! 

Thanks!
Button Punch Games
